## Description

Verify `experimental_userInterfaceStyle` on the Stack v4 header on iPhone Duo.
When the device is closed, UIKit moves the header items (back button, bar
button items) from the navigation bar to the vertical bar. A screen that
forces `dark` or `light` must show them in that style there too, while the
keyboard keeps following the system appearance and the next screen goes back
to the system style.

This guards against the vertical bar following the system appearance instead
of the forced style: the vertical bar does not inherit the style set on the
navigation bar.

## Note

- To toggle the system appearance on the iOS simulator, use Cmd+Shift+A.
- The prop does not change the status bar, which is shown at the top of the
  vertical bar. On a forced dark screen in light system appearance, the status
  bar text stays dark.

## Steps - iPhone Duo

### Baseline

1. Close the device, set the system appearance to **light** and open
   **Header Experimental UIStyle**.

   - [ ] "System style" screen is shown; the star and share items in the
         vertical bar are light.

2. Tap "Push forced dark screen".

   - [ ] "Forced dark" screen is shown with a black background.
   - [ ] The back button, star and share items in the vertical bar are dark
         (dark glass, white icons).

3. Tap the text field.

   - [ ] The keyboard is light.

4. Tap "Push screen without header", then tap "Go back".

   - [ ] "Forced dark" screen is shown again with dark items in the vertical
         bar.

5. Tap the back button in the vertical bar.

   - [ ] "System style" screen is shown with light items in the vertical bar.

---

### Forced light

1. Set the system appearance to **dark**, then tap "Push forced light screen".

   - [ ] "Forced light" screen is shown with a white background and light
         items in the vertical bar.

2. Tap the back button in the vertical bar.

   - [ ] "System style" screen is shown with dark items in the vertical bar.

---

### Unfolding

1. Set the system appearance to **light**, then tap
   "Push forced dark screen".

   - [ ] The back button, star and share items in the vertical bar are dark.

2. Open the device fully with the screen shown.

   - [ ] The header items are in the navigation bar and are dark.

3. Close the device with the screen shown.

   - [ ] The header items are back in the vertical bar and are still dark.

4. Tap the back button in the vertical bar.

   - [ ] "System style" screen is shown with light items in the vertical bar.
